title: Teller's name on a Project Sign/Grudge UFO review document
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Teller's name on a Project Sign/Grudge UFO review document, about late 1940s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a project sign or grudge document >> from pre-blue book >> in the late 40s and Edward Teller's name is on it where he's engaging in a real UFO review.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a document from Project Sign or Project Grudge, the US Air Force's first UFO studies in the late 1940s, before its better-known study called Blue Book, has the name of Edward Teller on it. Teller was the physicist behind the American hydrogen bomb. Michels says this shows Teller taking part in a serious UFO review, which would mean a top nuclear scientist took the subject seriously from the start.
